grain_rationale: The profile shows row_count 166158 and duplicate_row_rate 0.0, meaning every source row is a distinct line with no exact duplicate rows to collapse. No single column is unique on its own (flight_number has only 2994 distinct values against 166158 rows, and tail_number has 3825 distinct values with 0.009154 null_rate), so grain_type is transaction and a derived identity, flight_identity, hashes flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, and dest_airport, the tuple that identifies one flight occurrence per source row; with zero duplicate rows this tuple is expected to be unique and no aggregation is required.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: The calendar date of the flight, ranging from 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 across 181 distinct values with zero nulls, anchoring the business day of the scheduled departure.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: A two-letter carrier code (16 distinct values such as 9E, AA, DL) identifying the operating airline for the flight with no nulls.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: An integer flight number (1 to 8500, 2994 distinct values) that labels the operating route and is never summed, so it is a dimension rather than a measure.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: The three-letter origin airport code (EWR, JFK, LGA) with no nulls, identifying the departure airport of the flight.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: The scheduled departure time encoded as HHMM (500 to 2359, 969 distinct values) with no nulls, a label for the planned departure clock time rather than an aggregatable quantity.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: The three-letter destination airport code (100 distinct values such as ABQ, ACK) with no nulls, identifying the arrival airport of the flight.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: The aircraft tail number (3825 distinct values) is nullable at a null_rate of 0.009154, likely missing when a tail assignment was not recorded.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: A boolean flag with no nulls (distinct_values true/false) indicating whether the flight was cancelled.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: The actual departure time encoded as HHMM (1 to 2400, 1291 distinct values) is nullable at a null_rate of 0.029388, consistent with flights that never departed.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: The departure delay in minutes (-33 to 1301, 469 distinct values) is a measure summed or averaged across flights to track delay performance, nullable at a null_rate of 0.029388 matching flights that never departed.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: The actual arrival time encoded as HHMM (1 to 2400, 1392 distinct values) is nullable at a null_rate of 0.0307 for flights without a recorded arrival.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: The scheduled arrival time encoded as HHMM (1 to 2359, 1134 distinct values) with no nulls, a label for the planned arrival clock time.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: The arrival delay in minutes (-86 to 1272, 526 distinct values) is a measure aggregated to track arrival performance, nullable at a null_rate of 0.032981 for flights lacking a recorded arrival.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: The airborne flight duration in minutes (20 to 695, 484 distinct values) is a measure summed or averaged to analyze flight duration, nullable at a null_rate of 0.032981 matching flights with no recorded arrival.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: The great-circle distance flown in miles (80 to 4983, 203 distinct values) with no nulls, a measure used to sum or average distance flown.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: The scheduled local departure hour (5 to 23, 19 distinct values) with no nulls, a label component of the scheduled local departure time.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: The scheduled local departure minute (0 to 59, 60 distinct values) with no nulls, a label component of the scheduled local departure time.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: The scheduled departure timestamp in UTC, truncated to the hour (3439 distinct values ranging from 2013-01-01T10:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00) with no nulls, the event time for this fact.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: The full operating carrier name (16 distinct values such as Delta Air Lines Inc., United Air Lines Inc.) with no nulls, describing the carrier_code.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: The aircraft manufacturer name (34 distinct values such as AIRBUS, BOEING) is nullable at a null_rate of 0.160426 when the tail number could not be matched to an aircraft registration record.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: The aircraft model (121 distinct values such as 172E, 550) is nullable at a null_rate of 0.160426, matching missing aircraft registration matches.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: The year the aircraft was manufactured (1956 to 2013, 46 distinct values) is a label of aircraft age rather than a summed measure, nullable at a null_rate of 0.176531 for unmatched registrations.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: The aircraft's certificated seat count (2 to 450, 47 distinct values) is a measure that can be summed to estimate capacity offered, nullable at a null_rate of 0.160426 matching missing registration data.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: The aircraft engine type (6 distinct values such as Turbo-fan, Turbo-jet, Reciprocating) is nullable at a null_rate of 0.160426 matching missing registration data.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: The full origin airport name (3 distinct values: John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport) with no nulls.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: The origin airport's municipality (New York or Newark, 2 distinct values) with no nulls.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: The origin airport's elevation in feet (13, 18, or 21) with no nulls, a fixed characteristic of the airport rather than a summed measure.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: The origin airport's longest runway length in feet (7002, 11000, or 14511) with no nulls, a fixed airport characteristic.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: The full destination airport name (99 distinct values) is nullable at a null_rate of 0.02089, when the destination code could not be matched to an airport reference record.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: The destination airport's municipality (95 distinct values such as Albany, Atlanta) is nullable at a null_rate of 0.02089 matching unmatched destination references.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: The destination's ISO region code (45 distinct values such as US-CA, US-GA) is nullable at a null_rate of 0.02089 matching unmatched destination references.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: The destination airport's elevation in feet (3 to 6606, 90 distinct values) is a fixed airport characteristic, nullable at a null_rate of 0.02089 matching unmatched destination references.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: The destination airport's longest runway length in feet (5076 to 16000, 84 distinct values) is a fixed airport characteristic, nullable at a null_rate of 0.02089 matching unmatched destination references.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: An ingestion capture timestamp (16 distinct values clustered within seconds on 2026-09-02) with no nulls, recording when the row was captured by the pipeline rather than the business event time.

category_description: One row represents a single scheduled flight departure, identified by the combination of flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, and dest_airport, together with its departure and arrival timing, delay, cancellation status, distance, and the operating aircraft and airport reference attributes known at capture time.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver.silver_flights table enters the gold unified event star as the flights fact category, naming its grain, time column, and field roles for the deterministic modeling engine that renders the gold models from this contract.
usage: The modeling engine consumes this contract to generate the gold fact and its degenerate flight_identity key; the rendered draft is validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted with datacontract lint, and reviewed and approved by a human before any gold model is built.
limitations: This mapping does not filter or exclude cancelled flights (is_cancelled is carried as a flag, not applied as a filter) or rows with missing arrival, delay, or aircraft registration data (null_rate up to 0.176531 on aircraft_manufacture_year and up to 0.160426 on related aircraft fields); consumers must decide how to treat cancelled flights, unmatched aircraft registrations, unmatched destination references (null_rate 0.02089), and the non-business captured_at ingestion timestamp.
